name: Carousel
description: Slides shown one position at a time, with previous and next controls, indicators and optional autoplay.

children.description: The slides in order, one per top-level child: elements, text, or JSON `Media` descriptors.

index.description: Position shown (controlled): the index of the first visible slide, from 0; past the last position shows the last.

defaultIndex.description: Position shown on mount (uncontrolled), from 0; later changes are ignored.

slidesPerView.description: Slides visible side by side, a whole number from 1; each takes that share of the width. Default: 1.

loop.description: Previous and next, by control, key or swipe, wrap around at the ends instead of stopping there.

autoPlay.description: Advances one position per interval, after the last back to the first; any press or focus inside stops it, hover pauses it.

autoPlayInterval.description: Milliseconds each position shows before autoplay advances, from 100. Default: 3000.

labels.description: Names of the carousel's controls and slides, and the kinds they announce.

aria-label.description: Names the carousel region; without it and `aria-labelledby` the name is "Carousel".

ArrowRight.condition: focus on a carousel control; previousSlide in right-to-left text

ArrowLeft.condition: focus on a carousel control; nextSlide in right-to-left text

notes: The region announces labels.roleCarousel and is named "Carousel" until aria-label or aria-labelledby names it.
Each slide is a group announcing labels.roleSlide, named labels.slide; slides outside the view are inert.
The slides are a polite live region except while rotating; indicators mark the current position with aria-current.
Slides are the children; Button icon-only controls move between positions, and a rotation control appears with autoPlay.
slidesPerView, the position and the drag offset are runtime custom properties; the track's sign follows text direction.
Track transition uses shared Face UI motion tokens, which reduced motion shortens.
